method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md first; hash verification; atomscan slow with following disabled; cleave facts including decoded strings; static CIL/native/AutoIt execution-path analysis; isolated payload and positive/benign controls.

samples.marker: AutoIt RAT dropper: runs NetWire and AES-hidden Warzone; traits fixed
samples.identification: Obfuscated compiled AutoIt dropper for NetWire and AveMaria/WarzoneRAT
evidence: AutoIt-ripper extracted the compiled SCRIPT resource; 758 zero-argument ChrW/Execute helpers resolve constants. Numeric-state transitions order the active operations.

Top-level code concatenates AMSI1, UEVAGENTPOLICYGENERATOR2 and ACTXPRXY3 dialog resources. FMFWPBITQO derives AES-256 from an MD5 hash with CryptoAPI CryptDeriveKey and decrypts the hexadecimal ciphertext.

Removing valid PKCS#7 padding yields a 100352-byte native PE, SHA256 9f50debb6a78fe7582dfbf7ca2366871d68878c5728aa01a943b926604c81d55. This is a decoded payload, not an independently fetched original.

The active UHAPNZSLLLQVCSMDSVBPLKHZA call supplies this PE and the current image path to a 1474-byte RunPE stub invoked with DllCallAddress at offset 0xBE. Its export-name hashing resolves CreateProcessW, NtUnmapViewOfSection, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, Get/SetThreadContext and ResumeThread; the stub maps sections and redirects the child context.

Decoded Warzone: 0x407488 installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL with callback 0x4074c0. The callback translates/records keyboard input. 0x40adbb copies the Chrome Login Data database to a temporary file, reads SQLite credential rows and passes secret blobs to CryptUnprotectData at 0x40afab. Entry 0x410a7c invokes startup/configuration helpers and network initialization.

TKYGKKJGGLMEEHWTAJGNSZN extracts RCDATA RHITFGABOCNG, writes it into AppData and ShellExecutes it. Its 135168-byte native NetWire payload has a socket receive/dispatch loop at entry 0x402bcb, raw-input key translation and scrambled WriteFile recording.

NetWire 0x40c38b formats, writes and launches a temporary batch that deletes a selected image and its own batch path. Initialization 0x40c631 contains decoded Run-key writes; the AutoIt wrapper separately copies itself to AppData and schedules it every minute.
No supplied authorization or lab-deployment context explains the covert recording, credential extraction, multi-payload execution and disguised persistence.
limitations: The normal original-file scan carves NetWire but does not recover the AES-encrypted Warzone layer or decoded AutoIt behavior. Manual recovery followed by isolated scans exposes additional hook-keylogging and browser-password-decryption findings.

The generic unsigned high-entropy resource rule required only unrelated APIs and resource entropy. It established neither source-to-allocation binding nor concealment. All predicates and exclusions survive as a notable VirtualAlloc API profile; the unsupported suspicious loader inference is removed.

samples.marker: NanoCore-labeled RAT: surveillance, theft and shell; BootExecute trait
samples.identification: Custom NanoCore-labeled .NET surveillance RAT masquerading as Windows Update
evidence: The CLR entrypoint is MethodDef 0x06000033, RVA 0x2910. dnfile/dncil disassembly resolves method and member tokens; Main calls all recording, theft and control modules.

KeyloggerModule.Start installs hook type 13; HookCallback buffers timestamped window-title and key records. SendLoop appends local keylog text and calls SendToC2. Clipboard and screenshot worker delegates also serialize captured content for that sender.

PasswordRecoveryModule enumerates Chrome/Edge stores and calls SendFile on Login Data, Cookies and History. StartStealer enumerates Desktop/Documents/Downloads for selected extensions and files smaller than 5 MiB, and launches a netsh plaintext WLAN-profile query with stdout capture.

SendToC2 UTF-8 encodes records, XORs bytes with a 32-byte repeating key generated as index XOR 0xAA, Base64/URI-escapes them and issues a WebRequest GET. HTTP tasking consumes a response as cmd /c arguments and encodes command output; a separate outbound TcpClient connects cmd stdin/stdout through paired relay threads.

Main copies itself, writes a startup batch and HKCU Run values, creates an on-logon task, attempts a Session Manager BootExecute append, and starts a watchdog. It writes the ms-settings open command and DelegateExecute then launches fodhelper, executes hidden Defender-disable PowerShell, and attempts to create a local account and add it to Administrators.
Main calls NtSetInformationProcess with class 29, length 4 and a true flag. Its remote-thread injection path allocates/writes six bytes in a notepad child and passes the buffer to CreateRemoteThread.
The unsigned version resource claims Microsoft Windows Update. That deceptive packaging and automatic theft/control outweigh an unsupported assumption of authorized use.
limitations: C2_DOMAIN contains http://icode9.com; HTTP code prefixes http:// again, and TcpClient receives the scheme-bearing value as its hostname. These defects limit runtime delivery; findings describe code and attempts, not successful communications.

Webcam code sends message 0x425 instead of the SaveDIB value required by the existing camera trait. The microphone PowerShell recorder is implausible. These were not promoted to successful camera/audio capture.

TECHNIQUE:AMSI_Patch and TECHNIQUE:ETW_Patch only label messages. The ProcessHollowing label accompanies a remote-thread write of 31 C0 83 C0 64 C3 (return 100), not hollowing. No label-only evasion/hollowing traits were added.
BootExecute is read through a string cast despite normally being REG_MULTI_SZ; boot activation may fail. The new rule explicitly describes references, not a successful write or execution.
No sample was executed; authorization, victim configuration and observed runtime success remain unknown.

rule_review.removed_claim: Resource extraction/allocation API co-occurrence does not establish concealed payload loading.
rule_review.preservation: Exact predicates, scope and exclusions retained; criticality follows the neutral allocation-API observation.
rule_review.consumers: No exact YAML consumers of the old resource objective. Its three ancestor selectors are JavaScript/TypeScript-only; the relocated PE rule cannot supply them. The new memory-ancestor consumer is PowerShell-only. Exact batch-self-delete consumers and file-deletion ancestor consumers were inspected: script consumers have disjoint scope; the volume-ransomware consumer still requires volume enumeration, encryption APIs and ransom threats. Neither supplied sample nor the independent controls gained that finding.
rule_review.resource_leaf_audit: Reviewed the resource leaf for redundant effective definitions before relocation; no identical effective definitions. The retained observation is VirtualAlloc with resource context; underlying resource-access traits remain canonical.
new_behavior_coverage: Native raw-input keylogger with self-cleanup template
Managed hook keylogger with BootExecute and registry-setter references
rule_review.classifier_disagreement: None on either original. ML probabilities stay 0.99 and 0.98; no existing hostile detections are lost. The encrypted Warzone layer remains an automatic extraction/behavior-coverage gap.

controls.independent_comparison: All findings and severities unchanged on the two positive fixtures and the official AutoIt3.exe runtime.
controls.official_runtime: AutoIt 3.3.18.0, fetched from https://www.autoitscript.com/files/autoit3/autoit-v3.zip with forager; original archive and .forage.json kept in scratch. Removing Authenticode from separate copies is a static control, not an original release.
controls.source_engine: A rebuilt source-matched cleave was pinned in scratch after the installed validator rejected the checkout on a stale allowlist. Separate cache prevents YARA-version collisions with atomscan.
